test_overview: Evaluated the Flight Templates feature of the Pilot's Logbook app (React frontend :8000, FastAPI :8001). Anchors: D0=2026-08-08, D1=2026-08-07. All 10 steps passed. Created two Active aircraft (N100TP, N200TP); created template 'Coastal Hop' from the Add Flight form (form stayed open with values; no flight saved); verified applying the template prefills all fields except the Date (set to D1 then preserved); saved a flight and confirmed provenance 'Created from template: Coastal Hop' (no modified) plus usage '1 flight'; editing the flight kept provenance unchanged; editing the template (Day 1.2, Total 1.7) made the first flight show '(modified)'; created a second flight (unmodified) and renamed the template to 'Coastal Hop IFR', after which flight 1 showed 'Coastal Hop IFR (modified)' and flight 2 'Coastal Hop IFR' (rename propagates without altering modified state); archived N100TP (flight logbook unaffected) and confirmed applying the template then filled fields but cleared the aircraft (inactive not listed) and showed the inactive-aircraft banner, then saved a third flight on N200TP with unmodified provenance and usage '3 flights'; deleted the template and all three flights showed '[Deleted]' provenance; a flight created without any template shows no provenance banner at all. Minor deviation noted (not a point deduction): after clicking 'Save Changes' on a template edit the Edit panel does not auto-navigate back to the list even though the save succeeds. Total 68/68.

steps.description: Created N100TP (Cessna 172S, Airplane, SEL) and N200TP (Piper PA-28, Airplane, SEL); both shown in fleet with Active status badges.

Filled Add Flight with valid template-base data (D0, N100TP, KOAK->KSBA via 'Coastal via V27', Total 1.5/Day 1.0/Night 0.5, PIC 1.5, XC 1.5, DayTO 1, NightLDG 1, Approaches 2, Holds & Intercept checked, notes 'Template base') and saved as template 'Coastal Hop'. Form remained open with values intact; no flight was auto-saved.

Opened fresh Add Flight (date defaulted to D0), set Date to D1, applied 'Coastal Hop'; all fields prefilled (N100TP, KOAK->KSBA via V27, 1.5/1.0/0.5, PIC 1.5, XC 1.5, DayTO 1, NightLDG 1, 2 approaches, Holds+Intercept checked, notes 'Template base') and the Date stayed D1.
Set Date to D0 and saved; flight appeared in logbook; detail provenance 'Created from template: Coastal Hop' (no (modified)); Manage Templates usage '1 flight'.
Edited the flight (Notes 'Edited notes', XC 1.4) and saved; provenance stayed 'Created from template: Coastal Hop' without (modified).

Edited template (Day 1.0->1.2, Total 1.5->1.7) and saved (via keyboard Enter on Save button); flight 1 detail then showed 'Created from template: Coastal Hop (modified)'. Note: Edit panel does not auto-return to list after saving (minor UX quirk), but the save worked.

Created 2nd flight from edited template (Day 1.2/Total 1.7), Notes 'Second flight'; provenance unmodified. Renamed template to 'Coastal Hop IFR'. Flight 1 then 'Coastal Hop IFR (modified)', flight 2 'Coastal Hop IFR' (rename propagates, modified state preserved).

Archived N100TP. Applied template in Add Flight: fields filled, Aircraft cleared (inactive N100TP not in dropdown), shown the inactive-aircraft banner. Selected N200TP, Date D0, notes 'Third flight', saved (row-flight-3 N200TP). Provenance 'Created from template: Coastal Hop IFR' (no modified); usage '3 flights'.
Deleted 'Coastal Hop IFR' (accepted confirm); template list empty. All three flights ('Edited notes', 'Second flight', 'Third flight') showed provenance 'Created from template: [Deleted]'.
Created a flight without any template (D0, N200TP, KSFO->KOAK, Total 0.5/Day 0.5/Night 0, notes 'No template used'); saved; detail showed no provenance banner (0 text-flight-provenance elements).
